visual_identity.full_fusion_brief_en:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: C-06 PATCHWORK, new original human-worn sci-fi armor replacing Star Warfare Titan, legacy armor ID 5.
Reference inputs: the two attached images are the user's small Halo helmet examples, showing a very large enclosed wraparound glass face dome, thick cheek frame and sealed lower jaw. The original Star Warfare Titan's observed features are described below; that body reference is not attached to this call. Treat the user's two helmet references as the highest-priority helmet direction. Fuse them with Titan instead of using the previous generated white/green PATCHWORK design.
Primary request: design a NEW coherent improved wearable powered armor. The helmet is a HUMAN helmet with broad continuous curving amber-gold glass that extends high over the face and wraps toward the temples, influenced by both user examples. A low blue crown shield and thick blue/graphite cheek cradle hold this huge visor; closed reinforced lower jaw, short neck seal. The dome is not a detached robot head, not mechanical eyes, not a small horizontal slit. No Master Chief helmet, no 117, UNSC logo, or identical Halo panel outlines.
Keep Titan's identity: slate-blue armor, broad gold visor, compact heavy shoulder caps with warm yellow-orange lower edging, and exactly three tiny amber indicator dots on the OUTER face of EACH forearm in a small triangular arrangement. Recompose the chest as a broad blue horseshoe yoke around two shallow dark service recesses, separate overlapping lower rib plates, and a flexible black fabric waist. Shoulders remain substantial but slope away from the helmet; shorten their projection so arms can raise. Angular blue thighs, simple gold-edged knee guards, strong tapered blue shin shells and proportionate armored human boots.
Proportions: a stocky but unmistakably HUMAN wearer at approximately 6 to 6.5 helmet-heights, broad chest, strong thighs, normal joint positions, real cloth under-suit at neck/armpits/elbow/knee/waist, normal gloved hands with five fingers. Neither a chibi robot nor an elongated skinny realistic soldier. Armor shell silhouettes should read at game camera distance. Clear large shapes, restrained details.
Composition: one full-body standing figure, near-front three-quarter view, feet on ground, empty relaxed hands, all helmet and soles in frame. Portrait 1024 x 1536. Pale neutral gray studio background, soft neutral directional light, high-quality painted game concept render with low-poly-friendly broad bevels, matte armor, subtle edge wear, glossy gold visor. No weapon, captions or logos. No independent backpack visible in this front concept; the separate B-06 pack will be fitted in the later turnaround using its own design sheet. Preserve the user's helmet character, original Titan color identity and improve anatomy and armor articulation together.

actual_reviews.concept: 已目視：連續金色全罩玻璃、藍灰甲與金色肩緣成立；雙前臂各三點、可見軟頸與肘膝，正常五指手套。比原版更接近人穿戴；三視圖須固定肩緣與胸腹板數。
actual_reviews.construction: 已目視：金色連續全罩面窗、藍色外殼與軟內襯分開，肩上下板及布衣手臂清楚；B06紫紅雙窗外殼與框架/襯墊拆開，保留獨立背包與接軌。無工程尺寸；屬構造提案。
actual_reviews.turnaround: 正／左側／背面三視齊，身高與腳底基線近似一致；金色大面罩、藍灰甲、金肩緣、前臂三點跨視保留。B06紫紅双窗三角面以獨立背包配色呈現，未併入肩甲；細節仍需3D對齊。

proposed_stats.basis: 以 C-01 為比較點的未平衡提案，不是 Titan 現有數值；四件合計不含等級、背包與裝備升級；護盾容量不代表已具備回充功能
proposed_stats.unlock: 後續任務／製作解鎖提案，具體條件待定

proposed_abilities.name: 分裝修補
proposed_abilities.trigger: 完整四件、存活、有一份未使用的普通修補包，且沒有尚未消耗的自有分裝包；啟動後需連續操作1.2秒
proposed_abilities.effect: 完成時原子性地消耗一份普通修補包並產出兩份小包，各回復原包基礎治療量的40%；可自用或放在合法的腳邊地面由隊友拾取；完成時開始12秒冷卻
proposed_abilities.stop: 操作完成前受傷、取消、死亡或卸裝即中止，原包不消耗；完成的小包在卸裝後仍可用，擁有者死亡或離開場景時連同地面小包清除
proposed_abilities.limits: 同一來源最多兩份存續小包，每份有唯一識別以防重複拾取；總治療量為原包的80%，不可再次分裝或合併；不復活、不補盾、不溢補，滿血不消耗，任務道具及特殊補包不適用
proposed_abilities.visual: 裝甲前臂三個琥珀點顯示分裝進度，修復工具位待技能製作；B-06 為另一件裝備。
proposed_abilities.design_reason: 以總治療量減少換取分次分人使用的彈性，支援特色來自分配資源
proposed_abilities.integration_note: 需先核對消耗品、道具所有權、丟棄與拾取接口；此處未新增道具 ID 或執行期行為
proposed_abilities.equipment_dependency: 完整C裝甲四件；不要求同序B背包，不改B背包現有屬性。

modeling_authority: 本輪概念圖及逐張目視紀錄定義採用外觀；三視與拆解為建模參考。少量透視、遮擋或跨視細節須在模型統一，不可當精確尺寸、UV或已完工資產。
